enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly and deeply. Turns to the left side. Pulls blanket up to shoulders. Remains still. Turns to the right side. Adjusts pillow under head. Shifts legs. Stretches arms. Yawns. Turns onto back. Remains still. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning wash, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Lifts toilet lid. Urinates. Flushes toilet. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Applies soap. Rubs hands together. Rinses hands. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth with water. Spits into sink. Turns on tap. Rinses toothbrush. Turns off tap. Puts toothbrush back. Dries face with towel. Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt and pants. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Returns to bathroom. Looks in mirror. Combs hair.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast with tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk, eggs, and butter. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out frying pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into bowl. Adds milk. Whisk eggs with fork. Pours mixture into pan. Cooks scrambled eggs. Turns off stove. Transfers eggs to plate. Places bread in toaster. Presses lever. Toaster pops. Removes toast. Places on plate. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Kettle boils. Pours hot water into cup. Adds tea bag. Steeps tea. Removes tea bag. Adds milk. Sits at table. Eats eggs and toast. Drinks tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up the room and vacuuming the floors
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Picks up magazines from coffee table. Places magazines in rack. Picks up cushions from floor. Places cushions on sofa. Picks up empty cup from side table. Carries cup to kitchen. Returns to living room. Opens closet. Takes out vacuum cleaner. Plugs cord into wall outlet. Presses power button. Vacuum cleaner starts. Pushes vacuum across floor. Moves vacuum back and forth. Vacuum under sofa. Vacuum around coffee table. Presses power button. Vacuum cleaner stops. Unplugs cord. Wraps cord around vacuum. Opens closet. Puts vacuum away. Closes closet. Returns to sofa. Sits down.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens dishwasher. Takes out clean dishes. Dries dishes with towel. Places dishes in cabinet. Closes cabinet. Turns on tap. Fills sink with warm water. Adds dish soap. Picks up sponge. Washes plates. Rinses plates. Places plates in dish rack. Washes glasses. Rinses glasses. Places glasses in dish rack. Washes cutlery. Rinses cutlery. Places cutlery in dish rack. Drains sink. Turns off tap. Picks up spray bottle. Sprays counter with cleaner. Wipes counter with cloth. Rinses cloth. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth on hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote control. Presses power button. TV turns on. Presses channel button. Selects news channel. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Leans back on sofa. Crosses legs. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Watches TV. Presses channel button. Changes to movie channel. Watches movie. Gets up. Walks to kitchen. Returns with glass of water. Sits down. Drinks water. Places glass on side table. Watches TV. Presses power button. TV turns off. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a light lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens drawer. Takes out knife. Cuts lettuce. Cuts tomatoes. Cuts cheese. Places vegetables in bowl. Adds dressing. Tosses salad. Opens cabinet. Takes out plate. Places salad on plate. Picks up fork. Sits at table. Eats salad. Drinks water. Stands up. Places plate in sink. Places fork in sink. Washes hands. Dries hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the bed and browsing the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Lies down on bed. Picks up phone from nightstand. Presses power button. Unlocks phone. Opens social media app. Scrolls through feed. Taps like button. Continues scrolling. Opens messaging app. Reads messages. Types reply. Sends message. Opens browser. Reads news. Closes browser. Locks phone. Places phone on nightstand. Turns onto side. Closes eyes. Remains still.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping and running errands in the neighbourhood
enriched_activities.desc: Puts on jacket. Picks up wallet and keys. Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to grocery store. Enters store. Picks up basket. Walks to produce section. Selects apples. Places in basket. Selects bananas. Places in basket. Walks to dairy section. Selects milk. Places in basket. Selects yogurt. Places in basket. Walks to checkout. Places basket on counter. Pays with card. Receives receipt. Bags groceries. Walks out of store. Walks to post office. Enters post office. Buys stamps. Walks out. Walks to pharmacy. Enters pharmacy. Buys medicine. Walks out. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters house. Removes jacket. Places groceries on kitchen counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a leisurely walk in the local park
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to park. Enters park. Walks along path. Observes trees. Continues walking. Passes bench. Sits on bench. Rests. Stands up. Continues walking. Stops at pond. Watches ducks. Continues walking. Exits park. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters house.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Wets hands. Applies soap. Rubs hands together. Rinses hands. Turns off tap. Dries hands with towel. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies face wash. Rubs face. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Brushes hair. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on personal community program notes on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Presses power button. Waits for login. Enters password. Opens word processor. Creates new document. Types notes. Pauses. Reads notes. Types more. Saves document. Opens email. Checks inbox. Replies to email. Closes email. Opens calendar. Checks schedule. Closes calendar. Shuts down laptop. Closes laptop.

Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out chicken, vegetables, and sauce. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens drawer. Takes out knife. Cuts chicken. Cuts vegetables. Opens cabinet. Takes out pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Adds oil. Adds chicken. Stirs chicken. Adds vegetables. Stirs vegetables. Adds sauce. Stirs. Turns down heat. Covers pan. Simmers. Turns off stove. Opens cabinet. Takes out plate. Places food on plate.

Sits at table. Picks up fork. Eats chicken. Eats vegetables. Drinks water. Continues eating. Places fork down. Picks up glass. Drinks water. Places glass down. Picks up fork. Continues eating. Finishes meal. Stands up. Places plate in sink. Places fork in sink. Places glass in sink. Washes hands. Dries hands. Returns to table. Wipes table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing a game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Selects game channel. Picks up game controller. Turns on game console. Selects game. Plays game. Presses buttons. Moves controller. Pauses game. Puts controller down. Watches TV. Picks up controller. Resumes game. Plays game. Finishes game. Turns off game console. Puts controller down. Turns off TV. Stands up.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts temperature. Removes clothes. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rubs body. Rinses body. Applies shampoo. Rubs scalp. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around body. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Puts on pajamas. Lies on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens social media. Scrolls feed. Watches video. Taps like. Closes app. Opens settings. Sets alarm. Turns off phone. Places phone on nightstand. Turns off lamp. Lays head on pillow. Closes eyes.
Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Shifts legs. Adjusts pillow. Stretches arms. Yawns. Turns onto back. Remains still. Continues sleeping.
